line.length_definition: horizontal XY distance from south A to ridge-side Aprime
line.selected_by: user-fixed addendum4 line; no new candidates
line.coordinates_rule: retain original addendum4 precision; agrees with requested rounded XY within 5 micrometres
line.endpoint_z_rule: same inherited reference-height annotation used for all projections

metric_population: case_id=1 only among all saved reference rows within the fixed 1m strip
intersection_rule: single vertical centre plane; no strip averaging; disconnected pieces retained; coincident endpoints joined at 1e-6m

intersection_cache_use.judgment_mesh: exact original mesh centre-plane cut; no mesh reconstruction

ranking.rule: descending unrounded completeness of case 1 only; fixed line, no candidate selection or ranking tolerance
